newsitem.title: FRANCE: French agents accept fuel surcharges from Nov 16.
newsitem.headline: French agents accept fuel surcharges from Nov 16.

text.p: France's air freight forwarding association SNAGFA said its members had voted unanimously to accept airlines' fuel surcharges but only from November 16.
Previously SNAGFA had called for a postponent pending consultations between airlines and agents.

"Over the past week we have come to recognise the economic necessity of the surcharges but we still stick to our guns on being accorded, along with our thousands of customers, a reasonable period of prior notice before their application," SNAGFA General Secretary, Bruno Charrois, told Reuters.
SNAGFA members would not accept paying the surcharges before November 16, Charrois said.
Some airlines, notably Lufthansa, Air France and KLM implemented the surcharges from the beginning of the month.

"French agents have shown a good deal of pragmatism over this whole issue from the outset and this decision by SNAGFA is kind of a compromise. Now it's up to the airlines concerned to play their part and not seek a confrontation," Charrois said.
Air France Cargo said it had no intention of going back on its decision to implement the surcharges.
"Our position is unchanged, on ex-Europe routes, the surcharges are effective November 4," a cargo official at the airline said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
